typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Cluster as string,
		vCenter as string,
		{Total GHz} as string,
		{Socket Count} as string,
		{Core Count} as string,
		{Thread Count} as string,
		{Memory (GB)} as string,
		{HA Enabled} as string,
		{HA Failover Level} as string,
		{HA Admission Control} as string,
		{HA Restart Priority} as string,
		{HA Isolation Response} as string,
		{HA VM Monitoring} as string,
		{HA Advanced Options} as string,
		{DRS Enabled} as string,
		{DRS Automation Level} as string,
		{DRS vMotion Rate} as string,
		{DRS Advanced Options} as string,
		{DPM Enabled} as string,
		{vMotion Count} as string,
		{Host Count} as string,
		{Datastore Count} as string,
		{VM Count} as string,
		{Resource Pool Count} as string,
		Owner as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		VM_Count as string,
		Owner as string,
		DPM_Enabled as string,
		HA_Enabled as string,
		Datastore_Count as string,
		Total_GHz as string,
		DRS_vMotion_Rate as string,
		HA_Restart_Priority as string,
		HA_Isolation_Response as string,
		vMotion_Count as string,
		vCenter as string,
		DRS_Automation_Level as string,
		Resource_Pool_Count as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		HA_Failover_Level as string,
		Cluster as string,
		DRS_Enabled as string,
		Socket_Count as string,
		Core_Count as string,
		HA_Advanced_Options as string,
		Thread_Count as string,
		Memory__GB_ as string,
		DRS_Advanced_Options as string,
		Host_Count as string,
		HA_VM_Monitoring as string,
		HA_Admission_Control as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		VM_Count = {VM Count},
		Owner,
		DPM_Enabled = {DPM Enabled},
		HA_Enabled = {HA Enabled},
		Datastore_Count = {Datastore Count},
		Total_GHz = {Total GHz},
		DRS_vMotion_Rate = {DRS vMotion Rate},
		HA_Restart_Priority = {HA Restart Priority},
		HA_Isolation_Response = {HA Isolation Response},
		vMotion_Count = {vMotion Count},
		vCenter,
		DRS_Automation_Level = {DRS Automation Level},
		Resource_Pool_Count = {Resource Pool Count},
		ImportDate,
		HA_Failover_Level = {HA Failover Level},
		Cluster,
		DRS_Enabled = {DRS Enabled},
		Socket_Count = {Socket Count},
		Core_Count = {Core Count},
		HA_Advanced_Options = {HA Advanced Options},
		Thread_Count = {Thread Count},
		Memory__GB_ = {Memory (GB)},
		DRS_Advanced_Options = {DRS Advanced Options},
		Host_Count = {Host Count},
		HA_VM_Monitoring = {HA VM Monitoring},
		HA_Admission_Control = {HA Admission Control}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
